blocks.task_summary: Find the value of the car after 15% depreciation in the first year.
method_path: recognize 85% remaining or compute 15% then subtract

evidence.basis: M1: recognition that a 15% loss leaves 85% OR finding 15% and subtracting from original. A1: ($) 29750 =.

blocks.task_summary: Find the value after 10 years, with 11% yearly depreciation after first year, rounded to nearest dollar.
method_path: set up geometric term: 29750 * 0.89^9 or equivalent finance app parameters
accepted_alternatives: finance app: N=9, I%=11, PV=-29750, solve FV

evidence.basis: EITHER 29750 × 0.89^9 (A1) OR N=9 I%=11 PV=29750 ... THEN (A1) value (FV) = $10423. A1: answer must be rounded to the nearest dollar.

blocks.task_summary: Find least n such that car value is less than 10% of original after n complete years.
method_path: solve by logs, trial and error, table, or finance app
obtain n > 19.36... (or N > 18.36... if solving directly for years after first)
accepted_alternatives: METHOD 1: solve inequality 29750 * 0.89^(n-1) < 3500 by trial, table, logs
METHOD 2: use finance app with I%=11, PV=-29750, FV=3500, solve N then n=N+1

evidence.basis: METHOD 1: attempt to solve the inequality (or equation) ... M1; 19.3643... OR ... (A1); n = 20 A1. METHOD 2: use of the finance app ... M1; (N =) 18.3643... A1; n = 20 A1.
